name: Project Context page renders the clone-less states, and the agent's Context tab links back to it
description: L05. The seeded stack has NO clone — seed.ts inserts acme/payments-api with clonePath: null and scripts/e2e.sh uses an ephemeral Postgres — so this flow asserts exactly the states a clone-less stack produces: the sidebar entry navigates to /repos/:repoId/context, the page renders the not-yet-cloned state naming the clone as the missing prerequisite (AC-11), and the agent editor's Context tab renders '0 of 0 attached' with its link back to the page. Read-only: nothing here writes, so the flow is re-runnable against a stack it does not own. Opening a document, refreshing a scan and attaching a document are NOT reachable without a real clone, and faking one would mean writing into server/clones/** — those are covered by the server integration lane instead.

steps.label: not-yet-cloned state renders (AC-11)
